description:
Search PubMed.
Data: PubMed (NCBI E-utilities) · table records — one record = one PubMed citation record.
Key: pmid.
Results: ordered by the sort argument; `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. PubMed citations available at the time of the call (and before the run's literature ceiling when one is set).
a count of 0 is an unverified empty: PubMed search maps and expands terms, so no match is not evidence that nothing was published
records after the literature ceiling (or with no date) are withheld and listed in 'withheld'

query.description: Matched by the source's search engine: PubMed query syntax: automatic term mapping, field tags ([tiab], [si]) and Boolean operators.
